subject: Hausa
examFormat: The syllabus aims to prepare candidates for the Board's UTME in Hausa and to enable them to: read and write competently in Hausa; know the basic features of the Hausa language (syntax, phonology, morphology and semantics); have basic knowledge of oral and written Hausa literature; appreciate the culture, customs and institutions of the Hausa people; and translate competently from English to Hausa. It covers three areas: Harshe (Language), Al'adu (Culture) and Adabi (Literature, oral and written). Objectives for the culture and literature sections are written in Hausa in the syllabus and are kept as written.

topics.name: Ƙa'idojin Rubutu (Orthography)
objectives: recognize the basic Hausa orthographical rules
apply the Hausa orthographical rules
identify linguistic errors, such as grammar, wrong choice of words, wrong spelling etc
topics.content: Alphabetization, spelling, rules of word merger and division, punctuation and paragraphing, all in line with standard Hausa.

topics.name: Auna Fahimta (Comprehension)
objectives: read written Hausa texts
comprehend Hausa text in a given context
interpret various meanings and functions of words in a given text
acquire sufficient vocabulary
recognize central issues in a given text
draw conclusions based on available evidence in a given text
topics.content: Contextual questions from short unseen passages of about 200 words.

topics.name: Tsarin Rubutun Insha'i (Composition Techniques)
objectives: acquire the knowledge and techniques of composition writing in Hausa
recognize the different segments of composition in Hausa
recognize the different types of Hausa composition
topics.content: Argumentative, descriptive, dialogue, expository, narrative and letter writing.

topics.name: Fassara (Translation)
objectives: translate proverbial and idiomatic expressions and new words from English to Hausa
recognize the different types of translation
understand the basic techniques of translating proverbial and idiomatic expressions and new words into Hausa
identify the problems of translation into Hausa
topics.content: Ire-iren fassara (types of translation); ƙa'idojin fassara (rules of translation); matsalolin fassara (problems of translation); dabarun fassara (techniques of translation).

topics.name: Tsarin Sauti (Phonology)
objectives: analyse the process of sound production and combination of sounds to form meaningful words in Hausa
appraise the importance of vowels in determining meaning
distinguish between the phonetic attributes of sounds
recognize the number of syllables and their types in a word
analyse the phonological processes in Hausa
topics.content: Consonants: production and classification in terms of phonation, place and manner of articulation. Vowels: production and classification in terms of position of tongue and lips; monophthongs and diphthongs. Tone, e.g. high, low and falling tones. Syllable structure: syllable types, e.g. open and closed syllables, light and heavy syllables; syllabic categories of words, monosyllabic, disyllabic, etc. Vowel length: long and short vowels. Phonological processes, e.g. assimilatory (palatalization, labialization and vowel harmony) and non-assimilatory (insertion and deletion).

topics.name: Ƙirar Kalma (Morphology)
objectives: explain the roots and stems of Hausa words
explain the inflectional process in Hausa word formation
explain the derivational process of word formation in Hausa
differentiate between the two morphological processes
topics.content: Roots and stems; affixation, e.g. prefix, infix, suffix and their derivational and inflectional functions; gender and number inflections; derivation of nouns and adjectives from verbs, and of adjectives and verbs from nouns.

topics.name: Ginin Jumla (Syntax)
objectives: analyse the processes governing word combination to form phrases, clauses and sentences in Hausa
detect linguistic errors in the grammar
recognize ideas or thoughts in written form
construct grammatical sentences for effective communication
use the appropriate tenses in spoken and written Hausa
use the appropriate gender and number in spoken and written Hausa
differentiate between types of sentence structure
distinguish between nominal and verbal phrase
distinguish between types of sentences
compare types of clauses
topics.content: Word classes, e.g. nouns, pronouns, verbs, adverbs, adjectives, prepositions, conjunctions, interjections and ideophones. Grammatical categories, e.g. tense and aspect (general and relative past; general and relative continuous; first and second future; habitual); mood (subjunctive and negative); gender (masculine, feminine and neuter) and number (singular and plural). Sentence structure, e.g. verbal sentence, nominal phrase + verbal phrase and their components; non-verbal sentence: nominal phrase + stabilizer, nominal phrase + complement + stabilizer, nominal phrase + continuous frame (yana../yake...) (+da) + nominal phrase. Sentence types, e.g. simple, compound and complex sentences. Clauses: types (e.g. relative and subjunctive); functions (e.g. main and subordinate).

topics.name: Ma'ana (Semantics)
objectives: analyse the mechanisms of generating meanings in Hausa
build up their vocabulary
recognize the various meanings and functions of sentences in communication
use words and sentences suitable for a particular purpose
construct meaningful sentences for effective communication
topics.content: Lexical aspects of word meaning, e.g. ambiguity, synonym and antonym; figures of speech: aspects of specialized meanings of words and phrases, e.g. idioms, proverbs etc.

topics.name: Rayuwar Hausawa (Hausa Customs)
objectives: bayyana al'adun da ke tattare da ɗaukar ciki har zuwa samartaka
bayyana tasirin zamani a kan haihuwa
bayyana al'adun neman aure har zuwa zawarci
bayyana tasirin zamani akan aure
bayyana hanyoyin faɗar mutuwa zuwa rabon gado
bayyana tasirin zamani akan mutuwa
tantance ma'ana da ire-iren tasirin zamani
topics.content: Haihuwa (birth): ɗaukar ciki da goyon ciki da haihuwa da shayarwa da al'adun makon farko na haihuwa da wanka da ɓanti da yaye da kaciya da samartaka. Aure (marriage): ire-irensa da nema da baiko da ɗaurin aure da biki da zaman aure da saki da zawarci. Mutuwa (death): faɗar mutuwa da wanka da salla da jana'iza da zaman makoki da sadaka da takaba da gado. Tasirin zamani akan rayuwar Hausawa.

topics.name: Zamantakewa (Social Institutions)
objectives: bayyana tsarin dangantaka da mu'amala tsakanin iyali
bayyana muhimmancin zamantakewa a tsakanin Hausawa
tantance ire-iren tasirin zamani a kan al'adun zamantakewa
topics.content: Tsarin zaman iyali da zaman gandu da dangantakar kishiyoyi da 'yan uwantaka da barantaka da agolanci; maƙwabtaka; aikin gandu da na gayya; abota da ƙawance; gaisuwa da karamci; tasirin zamani a kan zamantakewa.

topics.name: Sana'o'in Gargajiya (Traditional Occupations)
objectives: tantance ɗabi'un masu sana'a
tantance kayayyakin da ake sana'antawa
tantance sana'o'in maza da na mata
zayyana kayayyakin sana'o'in
tantance hanyoyin gadon sana'o'in
zayyana amfanin kayayyakin sana'o'in
bayyana sarautun sana'o'in
bayyana muhimmancin sana'o'in
tantance tasirin zamani akan sana'o'in
topics.content: Ire-irensu: noma da ƙira da jima da kasuwanci da wanzanci da sassaƙa da farauta da dukanci da saƙa da kitso da rini da fawa da fafar ƙorai, da sauransu. Yanayinsu: hanyoyin gadon su da kayayyakin yin su da matakan tafiyar da su da muhimmancinsu. Kayayyaki ko amfanin da suke samarwa; sarautunsu; sana'o'i masu dangantaka da jinsi: aikatau da ƙwadago; kitso da aski; tasirin zamani a kan sana'o'in gargajiya.

topics.name: Kayayyakin Buƙatun Rayuwa (Material Culture)
objectives: tantance kayayyakin buƙatun rayuwa na Hausawa
tantance amfanin kayayyakin buƙatun rayuwa na Hausawa
tantance tasirin zamani a kan kayayyakin buƙatun rayuwa na Hausawa
topics.content: Na buƙatun cikin gida (household): tufafi da karikitan cikin gida. Na sauran buƙatu (others): gine-gine da girke-girke da sauransu. Tasirin zamani a kan kayayyakin buƙatuwa.

topics.name: Bukukuwa da Wasanni (Hausa festivities and recreational activities)
objectives: zayyana ire-iren wasanni da bukukuwan Hausawa
nuna mahimancinsu
nuna yadda za a adana su kada su ɓace
nuna yadda ake gudanar da su
nuna tasirin zamani a kan bukukuwa da wasanni
topics.content: Na addini (religious): irin su bikin salla da takutaha (sallar gani) da cika-ciki da saukar karatu. Na gargajiya (traditional): irin su kalankuwa da buɗar dawa, da bikin shan kabewa. Na sana'a (occupational): bikin kamun kifi da dambe da kokawa da wasan farauta da wasan maƙera da hawan ƙaho. Na nishaɗi: sukuwa. Na yara (children's games): irin su shalle da kulli-kurciya da a-sha-ruwan-tsuntsaye da gaɗa da carafke. Tasirin zamani kan bukukuwa da wasanni.

topics.name: Camfe-camfe da Bauta (Traditional Beliefs and Worship)
objectives: tantance ire-ire da hanyoyin aiwatar da su
bayyana amfaninsu
bayyana rashin amfaninsu
bayyana tasirin zamani a kansu
topics.content: Camfe-camfe irin su kangida da camfi, da kambun baka da maita; bauta irin su bori da tsafi; tasirin zamani a kan camfe-camfe da bauta.

topics.name: Sarautun Gargajiya (Traditional Authority)
objectives: zayyana su ta fuskar ire-iren muƙamai
zayyana matakan muƙamai
tantance aikin kowane mai muƙami
tantance mahimmancin kowane muƙami
bayyana tasirin zamani a kansu
topics.content: Ire-iren su: sarakuna da hakimai da dagatai da masu unguwanni; na bayin sarki: shantali da jakadiya da baraya da sauransu; masu alaƙa da addini, irin su liman da alƙali; ayyukansu; tasirin zamani a kan sarautun gargajiya.

topics.name: Magungunan Gargajiya (Traditional Medicine)
objectives: karkasa ire-iren magunguna
zayyana hanyoyin amfani da su
fito da amfaninsu
nuna tasirin zamani a kan su
topics.content: Ire-iren su: na gargajiya (sassaƙe-sassaƙe da sawyoyi da na gari da na ruwa); na addini (layu da rubutu da ɗibbu da duba). Hanyar amfani da su: sha da shafawa da surace da turare da shaƙawa da taunawa da tsotsawa da ɗaurawa da liƙawa da ratayawa. Tsarin amfani da su: awo da kimantawa. Ayyukansu: riga-kafi da warkarwa. Tasirin zamani a kansu.

topics.name: Zuben Baka (Narratives)
objectives: tantance nau'o'in zuben baka
amfani da kalmomin da suka dace da kan labari
topics.content: Irin su tatsuniya da almara da hikaya da ƙissa da tarihi da sauransu. UTME 2026-2030 set text (oral prose): Mu Sha Dariya by B. O. Tofa (NNPC, Zaria, 2018).

topics.name: Maganganun Azanci (Folk-sayings)
objectives: tantance sigogi da bayyana hanyoyin amfani da su
naƙalta da amfani da kalmomin da suka dace da maganganun azanci
topics.content: Irin su take da kirari da habaici da zambo da karin magana da kacici-kacici da salon magana da adon magana da sauransu.

topics.name: Waƙoƙi na baka (Oral songs)
objectives: tantance ire-iren waƙoƙin baka
tantance masu yin ire-iren waƙoƙin
rarrabe siga da turke (jigo) da salo da zubi da kayayyakin aiwatar da su
tantance nau'o'in waƙoƙin aiki
tantance masu yin waƙoƙin aiki
bambance sigogin waƙoƙin yara
topics.content: Ire-iren su: na fada da na jama'a da na maza da na sha'awa da sauransu; turke (jigo) da salo da zubi da tsari da mawaƙi da kayan kiɗa da abin da aka waƙe. Waƙoƙin aiki: na niƙa da daɓe da na daka da na talla da sauransu. Waƙoƙin yara (maza da mata); na aure da na dandali da sauransu. UTME 2026-2030 set text (oral poetry): Jagoran Nazarin Waƙar Baka by S. M. Gusau (Benchmark Publishers Ltd, 2003).

subtopics.name: Jagoran Nazarin Waƙar Baka (Gusau, S. M.)

topics.name: Wasannin Kwaikwayo Na Gargajiya (Traditional Drama)
objectives: tantance sigogin wasannin kwaikwayo na gargajiya
tantance hanyoyin gudanar da wasannin kwaikwayo na gargajiya
fito da muhimmancin wasannin kwaikwayo na gargajiya
fayyece bambancin wasan kwaikwayo na yara da na manya
topics.content: Na yara: ire-irensu (langa da wasan 'yartsana da tashe da wasan gauta da dokin kara da sauransu); yadda ake yin su; muhimmancinsu. Na manya: ire-irensu ('yan kama da kalankuwa da hoto da wowwo da tashe, da sauransu); yadda ake yinsu; muhimmancinsu. UTME 2026-2030 set text (oral drama): Wasannin Tashe by M. B. Umar (NNPC, Zaria, 2009).

objectives: tantance siga da tsari da jigo da salo da taurarin cikin littafin zube tare da nazarin su
naƙaltar ƙa'idojin rubutu yayin karanta rubutun zube
naƙaltar ma'anonin kalmomi da na jumloli domin fahimtar labari
tantance muhimman saƙonni a cikin labari da yanke hukunci game da labarin
topics.content: Rubutaccen Adabi (Written Literature). Prescribed text for UTME 2026-2030.

yin la'akari da ƙa'idojin rubutu musamman na waƙa
tantance ma'anonin kalmomi da na jumloli wajen nazarin waƙa
danganta amfani da kalmomi da jumloli da saƙon waƙa
tantance muhimman saƙonni a cikin waƙa da yanke hukunci game da ita
